questions.answer_en: Scope, assumptions, architecture, data model, interfaces, functional behavior, security, performance, accessibility, error handling, testing, migration/deployment, operations and acceptance criteria.
questions.answer_el: Scope, assumptions, architecture, data model, interfaces, functional behavior, security, performance, accessibility, error handling, testing, migration/deployment, operations και acceptance criteria.

questions.question_en: Convert 'Students must be able to register for courses online' into detailed functional requirements.
questions.question_el: Μετατρέψτε «Students must be able to register for courses online» σε detailed functional requirements.
questions.answer_en: Define authentication, eligible course listing, registration window, prerequisite/capacity/conflict checks, duplicate prevention, transactional persistence, confirmation, cancellation rules and staff overrides if allowed.
questions.answer_el: Ορίστε authentication, eligible course listing, registration window, prerequisite/capacity/conflict checks, duplicate prevention, transactional persistence, confirmation, cancellation rules και staff overrides αν επιτρέπονται.

questions.question_en: Identify possible non-functional requirements for that registration system.
questions.question_el: Εντοπίστε πιθανά non-functional requirements για το registration system.
questions.answer_en: Peak-load response time, availability, security/privacy, accessibility, auditability, backup/recovery, maintainability, compatibility and integration reliability.
questions.answer_el: Peak-load response time, availability, security/privacy, accessibility, auditability, backup/recovery, maintainability, compatibility και integration reliability.

questions.question_en: How would you document database requirements?
questions.answer_en: Use data definitions, ER models, keys/cardinalities, constraints, data ownership, volumes/growth, retention, security/classification, transaction rules, performance needs, integrations and migration requirements.
questions.answer_el: Με data definitions, ER models, keys/cardinalities, constraints, data ownership, volumes/growth, retention, security/classification, transaction rules, performance, integrations και migration requirements.

questions.question_en: How would you determine whether the delivered system satisfies the original requirements?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα διαπιστώνατε αν το παραδοτέο σύστημα ικανοποιεί τα αρχικά requirements;
questions.answer_en: Trace requirements to tests/evidence, run functional and non-functional testing, perform UAT and obtain formal acceptance against agreed criteria.
questions.answer_el: Κάντε trace requirements σε tests/evidence, functional/non-functional testing, UAT και formal acceptance βάσει συμφωνημένων criteria.

topics.source_basis: The role includes development, configuration, integration, maintenance and upgrades.

questions.answer_en: A structured lifecycle for planning, requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, operation, maintenance and retirement of software.
questions.answer_el: Δομημένος lifecycle για planning, requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, operation, maintenance και retirement λογισμικού.

questions.question_en: Describe the main phases of the SDLC.
questions.answer_en: Typical phases are planning/feasibility, requirements, architecture/design, implementation, testing, deployment, operation/support, maintenance and retirement.
questions.answer_el: Συνήθως planning/feasibility, requirements, architecture/design, implementation, testing, deployment, operation/support, maintenance και retirement.

questions.question_en: Explain Requirements → Design → Development → Testing → Deployment → Maintenance.
questions.question_el: Εξηγήστε Requirements → Design → Development → Testing → Deployment → Maintenance.
questions.answer_en: Requirements define needs; design defines the solution; development builds it; testing verifies it; deployment releases it; maintenance operates and improves it.
questions.answer_el: Requirements ορίζουν ανάγκες, design τη λύση, development την υλοποιεί, testing την επαληθεύει, deployment την κυκλοφορεί και maintenance τη λειτουργεί/βελτιώνει.

questions.answer_en: Waterfall is largely sequential and phase-driven; Agile delivers iteratively in small increments with frequent feedback and reprioritization.
questions.answer_el: Waterfall είναι κυρίως sequential/phase-driven· Agile παραδίδει iteratively σε μικρά increments με συχνό feedback και reprioritization.

questions.question_en: What are advantages and disadvantages of Agile?
questions.question_el: Ποια είναι πλεονεκτήματα και μειονεκτήματα Agile;
questions.answer_en: Advantages: rapid feedback, adaptability and incremental value. Risks: poor predictability or architecture if discipline is weak, and it still requires governance/documentation appropriate to context.
questions.answer_el: Πλεονεκτήματα: γρήγορο feedback, adaptability, incremental value. Κίνδυνοι: χαμηλή predictability/architecture αν λείπει discipline· εξακολουθεί να απαιτεί κατάλληλο governance/documentation.

questions.answer_en: An Agile framework using a Product Backlog, Sprints, defined accountabilities and events to deliver increments iteratively.
questions.answer_el: Agile framework με Product Backlog, Sprints, καθορισμένα accountabilities και events για iterative delivery increments.

questions.answer_en: A fixed-length Scrum iteration, one month or less, during which a usable Increment is created toward a Sprint Goal.
questions.answer_el: Fixed-length Scrum iteration έως έναν μήνα, κατά την οποία δημιουργείται usable Increment προς Sprint Goal.

questions.answer_en: Product Backlog is the ordered evolving work for the product; Sprint Backlog is the selected work and plan for the current Sprint.
questions.answer_el: Product Backlog είναι το ordered evolving work για το product· Sprint Backlog το selected work και plan του current Sprint.

questions.answer_en: A system that records file changes over time, supporting history, collaboration, branching, review and rollback.
questions.answer_el: Σύστημα που καταγράφει αλλαγές files στον χρόνο, με history, collaboration, branching, review και rollback.

questions.answer_en: It is distributed, supports efficient branching/merging, history and collaboration, and integrates widely with code review and CI/CD.
questions.answer_el: Είναι distributed, υποστηρίζει branching/merging, history/collaboration και ενσωματώνεται ευρέως με code review και CI/CD.

questions.answer_en: Peer examination of proposed changes to improve correctness, security, maintainability, consistency and knowledge sharing.
questions.answer_el: Peer examination προτεινόμενων changes για correctness, security, maintainability, consistency και knowledge sharing.

questions.question_en: Why use separate development, testing and production environments?
questions.question_el: Γιατί ξεχωριστά development, testing και production environments;
questions.answer_en: To isolate experimentation and validation from real users/data, reduce risk and support controlled repeatable releases.
questions.answer_el: Για απομόνωση experimentation/validation από real users/data, μείωση risk και controlled repeatable releases.

questions.answer_en: Continuous Integration automates frequent build/test of changes; Continuous Delivery/Deployment automates reliable packaging and release toward or into production.
questions.answer_el: Continuous Integration αυτοματοποιεί build/test συχνών changes· Continuous Delivery/Deployment αυτοματοποιεί αξιόπιστο packaging/release προς ή μέσα σε production.

questions.answer_en: Future cost and risk created by expedient technical choices that reduce maintainability, quality or flexibility.
questions.answer_el: Μελλοντικό κόστος/risk από βιαστικές τεχνικές επιλογές που μειώνουν maintainability, quality ή flexibility.

questions.answer_en: Agreed rules for code style, structure, naming, error handling, security and maintainability that improve consistency and reviewability.
questions.answer_el: Συμφωνημένοι κανόνες για style, structure, naming, error handling, security και maintainability ώστε ο κώδικας να είναι συνεπής και reviewable.

questions.answer_en: Separating distinct responsibilities into components/layers so changes have limited impact and code is easier to reason about.
questions.answer_el: Διαχωρισμός διαφορετικών responsibilities σε components/layers ώστε changes να έχουν περιορισμένο impact και ο κώδικας να είναι ευκολότερος.

questions.answer_en: Designing a system as cohesive, loosely coupled modules with clear interfaces and responsibilities.
questions.answer_el: Σχεδιασμός συστήματος ως cohesive, loosely coupled modules με σαφή interfaces και responsibilities.

questions.answer_en: The ease and safety with which software can be understood, corrected, tested, adapted and extended over time.
questions.answer_el: Η ευκολία και ασφάλεια με την οποία λογισμικό κατανοείται, διορθώνεται, δοκιμάζεται, προσαρμόζεται και επεκτείνεται.

questions.answer_en: The ability to handle increased workload by adding resources or improving architecture without unacceptable degradation.
questions.answer_el: Η ικανότητα χειρισμού αυξημένου workload με επιπλέον resources ή architecture improvements χωρίς απαράδεκτη degradation.

questions.answer_en: Vertical scaling gives a server more CPU/RAM/etc.; horizontal scaling adds more instances and distributes load.
questions.answer_el: Vertical scaling αυξάνει CPU/RAM κ.λπ. ενός server· horizontal scaling προσθέτει instances και κατανέμει load.

questions.answer_en: An architecture separating presentation, application/business logic and data tiers.
questions.answer_el: Αρχιτεκτονική που διαχωρίζει presentation, application/business logic και data tiers.

questions.question_en: Explain presentation, business logic and data layers.
questions.question_el: Εξηγήστε presentation, business logic και data layers.
questions.answer_en: Presentation handles UI; business logic applies rules/workflows; data layer manages persistence and database interaction.
questions.answer_el: Presentation χειρίζεται UI, business logic rules/workflows και data layer persistence/database interaction.

questions.answer_en: A monolith packages most functionality in one deployable system; distributed systems split functionality across networked components, gaining independent scaling but adding operational/network complexity.
questions.answer_el: Monolith συγκεντρώνει λειτουργίες σε ένα deployable system· distributed systems τις χωρίζουν σε networked components με independent scaling αλλά περισσότερη operational/network complexity.

questions.answer_en: A defined contract by which software components exchange requests/data and invoke capabilities.
questions.answer_el: Καθορισμένο contract μέσω του οποίου software components ανταλλάσσουν requests/data και καλούν capabilities.

questions.answer_en: An architectural style centered on resources, standard HTTP semantics, stateless interactions and representations such as JSON.
questions.answer_el: Architectural style με resources, standard HTTP semantics, stateless interactions και representations όπως JSON.

questions.question_en: Explain GET, POST, PUT/PATCH and DELETE.
questions.question_el: Εξηγήστε GET, POST, PUT/PATCH και DELETE.
questions.answer_en: GET retrieves; POST creates or initiates processing; PUT replaces/upserts a resource representation; PATCH partially modifies; DELETE removes.
questions.answer_el: GET retrieves, POST creates/initiates processing, PUT replaces/upserts resource representation, PATCH κάνει partial modification, DELETE removes.

questions.answer_en: Three-digit response codes describing the outcome class of an HTTP request: informational, success, redirection, client error or server error.
questions.answer_el: Τριψήφιοι response codes που περιγράφουν outcome class HTTP request: informational, success, redirection, client error ή server error.

questions.answer_en: 200 success; 201 created; 400 invalid request; 401 authentication required/failed; 403 authenticated but forbidden; 404 resource not found; 500 unexpected server error.
questions.answer_el: 200 success, 201 created, 400 invalid request, 401 authentication required/failed, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 500 unexpected server error.

questions.answer_en: A lightweight text data-interchange format built from objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans and null.
questions.answer_el: Ελαφρύ text data-interchange format με objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans και null.

questions.answer_en: JSON is compact and maps naturally to common program structures; XML is markup-based, supports attributes/namespaces and rich schema/document tooling. Choice depends on the contract/ecosystem.
questions.answer_el: JSON είναι compact και ταιριάζει σε program structures· XML είναι markup-based με attributes/namespaces και πλούσιο schema/document tooling. Η επιλογή εξαρτάται από contract/ecosystem.

questions.question_en: What does stateless mean in REST?
questions.answer_en: Each request contains what the server needs to process it without relying on hidden conversational state from previous requests.
questions.answer_el: Κάθε request περιέχει ό,τι χρειάζεται ο server χωρίς να βασίζεται σε hidden conversational state προηγούμενων requests.

questions.answer_en: A strategy for evolving an API contract while managing compatibility, such as URI, header or media-type versions plus deprecation policy.
questions.answer_el: Στρατηγική εξέλιξης API contract με compatibility management, π.χ. URI/header/media-type versions και deprecation policy.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy explicitly requires interfaces and data exchange between systems.

questions.answer_en: Connecting independent systems so they exchange data and coordinate processes reliably.
questions.answer_el: Σύνδεση ανεξάρτητων systems ώστε να ανταλλάσσουν data και να συντονίζουν processes αξιόπιστα.

questions.answer_en: A formal interface/contract exposing operations and data to other software.
questions.answer_el: Τυπικό interface/contract που εκθέτει operations και data σε άλλο software.

questions.answer_en: An HTTP API designed around resources and REST principles, commonly exchanging JSON representations.
questions.answer_el: HTTP API σχεδιασμένο γύρω από resources και REST principles, συνήθως με JSON.

questions.answer_en: REST is an architectural style commonly using HTTP/JSON; SOAP is a formal XML messaging protocol with standardized WS-* features.
questions.answer_el: REST είναι architectural style συνήθως με HTTP/JSON· SOAP formal XML messaging protocol με standardized WS-* features.

questions.answer_en: A network-accessible software service exposing machine-to-machine functionality via a defined protocol/interface such as REST or SOAP.
questions.answer_el: Network-accessible software service που εκθέτει machine-to-machine functionality μέσω ορισμένου protocol/interface όπως REST ή SOAP.

questions.answer_en: A lightweight structured text format commonly used for API payloads.
questions.answer_el: Ελαφρύ structured text format που χρησιμοποιείται συχνά για API payloads.

questions.answer_en: A text markup format representing hierarchical structured data with elements, attributes and namespaces.
questions.answer_el: Text markup format για hierarchical structured data με elements, attributes και namespaces.

questions.answer_en: Converting in-memory structures into a transport/storage representation; deserialization reconstructs them.
questions.answer_el: Μετατροπή in-memory structures σε transport/storage representation· deserialization τα ανακατασκευάζει.

questions.answer_en: A specific network address plus operation through which an API resource/capability is accessed.
questions.answer_el: Συγκεκριμένη network address και operation μέσω της οποίας προσπελαύνεται API resource/capability.

questions.answer_en: The mechanism that establishes the identity of a caller using credentials/tokens/certificates or another scheme.
questions.answer_el: Ο μηχανισμός που ταυτοποιεί caller με credentials/tokens/certificates ή άλλο scheme.

questions.answer_en: An API key usually identifies/authenticates an application with a shared credential; OAuth is an authorization framework for delegated/scoped token access and supports richer identity flows.
questions.answer_el: API key συνήθως ταυτοποιεί application με shared credential· OAuth είναι authorization framework για delegated/scoped token access με πλουσιότερα identity flows.

questions.answer_en: An authorization framework where clients obtain scoped access tokens instead of directly receiving a resource owner's credentials.
questions.answer_el: Authorization framework όπου clients λαμβάνουν scoped access tokens αντί να παίρνουν απευθείας credentials του resource owner.

questions.answer_en: A compact token format carrying claims and protected by a signature/MAC; security depends on correct algorithm, key, issuer, audience and expiry validation.
questions.answer_el: Compact token format με claims και signature/MAC· η ασφάλεια εξαρτάται από σωστό validation algorithm, key, issuer, audience και expiry.

questions.answer_en: An HTTP callback sent to another system when an event occurs, enabling event-driven integration without constant polling.
questions.answer_el: HTTP callback προς άλλο system όταν συμβεί event, για event-driven integration χωρίς συνεχές polling.

questions.answer_en: Synchronous calls wait for a response in the request path; asynchronous integration decouples processing through queues/events or deferred work.
questions.answer_el: Synchronous calls περιμένουν response στο request path· asynchronous integration αποσυνδέει processing μέσω queues/events ή deferred work.

questions.answer_en: A pattern where producers place messages in durable/intermediate queues for consumers to process independently.
questions.answer_el: Pattern όπου producers βάζουν messages σε durable/intermediate queues και consumers τα επεξεργάζονται ανεξάρτητα.

questions.question_en: Why use queues instead of direct API calls?
questions.question_el: Γιατί queues αντί direct API calls;
questions.answer_en: Queues provide decoupling, buffering, retry capability and resilience to temporary consumer outages, but introduce eventual processing and operational complexity.
questions.answer_el: Queues προσφέρουν decoupling, buffering, retries και resilience σε προσωρινά outages, αλλά εισάγουν eventual processing και operational complexity.

questions.answer_en: Controlled repetition of transiently failed operations, normally with limits, backoff and observability.
questions.answer_el: Ελεγχόμενη επανάληψη transiently failed operations, συνήθως με limits, backoff και observability.

questions.question_en: Why can blindly retrying requests cause problems?
questions.question_el: Γιατί τα blind retries προκαλούν προβλήματα;
questions.answer_en: They can duplicate non-idempotent actions and amplify load on an already failing dependency, causing retry storms.
questions.answer_el: Μπορούν να διπλασιάσουν non-idempotent actions και να ενισχύσουν load σε ήδη failing dependency, δημιουργώντας retry storms.

questions.answer_en: The property that repeating the same operation has no additional business effect after the first successful application.
questions.answer_el: Η ιδιότητα όπου η επανάληψη της ίδιας operation δεν έχει πρόσθετο business effect μετά την πρώτη επιτυχία.

questions.question_en: Why is idempotency important in integrations?
questions.question_el: Γιατί είναι σημαντικό το idempotency σε integrations;
questions.answer_en: Distributed systems may deliver/retry messages more than once; idempotency prevents duplicate business effects.
questions.answer_el: Distributed systems μπορεί να κάνουν delivery/retry πάνω από μία φορά· idempotency αποτρέπει duplicate business effects.

questions.question_en: System A succeeds in sending a transaction but does not receive System B's acknowledgement. What should happen?
questions.question_el: Το System A στέλνει επιτυχώς transaction αλλά δεν λαμβάνει acknowledgement από B. Τι πρέπει να γίνει;
questions.answer_en: Treat the outcome as unknown, not failed. Retry safely using an idempotency key or query/reconcile status so a duplicate business transaction cannot be created.
questions.answer_el: Θεωρήστε το outcome unknown, όχι failed. Κάντε safe retry με idempotency key ή query/reconciliation status ώστε να μην δημιουργηθεί duplicate business transaction.

questions.question_en: How would you prevent duplicate transactions?
questions.answer_en: Use stable transaction/request IDs, unique constraints, idempotency keys, deduplication state and atomic database handling.
questions.answer_el: Με stable transaction/request IDs, unique constraints, idempotency keys, deduplication state και atomic database handling.

questions.question_en: How should integration failures be logged?
questions.answer_en: Record timestamp, correlation ID, source/target, operation, safe error details, status and retry count while excluding secrets and unnecessary personal data.
questions.answer_el: Καταγράψτε timestamp, correlation ID, source/target, operation, ασφαλή error details, status και retry count, χωρίς secrets και περιττά personal data.

questions.answer_en: Extract data from sources, Transform it into the required representation, then Load it into the target.
questions.answer_el: Extract από sources, Transform στην απαιτούμενη μορφή και Load στο target.

questions.answer_en: ETL transforms before loading; ELT loads first and transforms using the target platform's compute capabilities.
questions.answer_el: ETL κάνει transform πριν το load· ELT load πρώτα και transform μέσα στο target platform.

questions.question_en: How would you integrate a new student-management application with an existing finance system?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα διασυνδέατε νέο student-management application με υπάρχον finance system;
questions.answer_en: Define data ownership and contract, identifiers/mappings, secure authentication, validation, sync/async pattern, transactions/idempotency, errors/retries, reconciliation, monitoring, SLA and change/version management.
questions.answer_el: Ορίστε data ownership/contract, identifiers/mappings, secure authentication, validation, sync/async pattern, transactions/idempotency, errors/retries, reconciliation, monitoring, SLA και version management.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy explicitly names information security as part of correct and uninterrupted system operation.

questions.answer_en: Confidentiality prevents unauthorized disclosure; integrity protects correctness and unauthorized modification; availability ensures authorized access when needed.
questions.answer_el: Confidentiality αποτρέπει unauthorized disclosure, integrity προστατεύει correctness/unauthorized modification και availability εξασφαλίζει authorized access όταν χρειάζεται.

questions.answer_en: Authentication verifies identity; authorization determines permitted actions/resources.
questions.answer_el: Authentication επαληθεύει identity· authorization καθορίζει επιτρεπόμενες actions/resources.

questions.answer_en: Give users/services only the minimum permissions needed for their tasks and only for the required duration.
questions.answer_el: Δώστε σε users/services μόνο τα ελάχιστα permissions που χρειάζονται και μόνο για την απαιτούμενη διάρκεια.

questions.answer_en: Role-Based Access Control groups permissions into roles and assigns roles to users, simplifying consistent authorization.
questions.answer_el: Role-Based Access Control ομαδοποιεί permissions σε roles και αναθέτει roles σε users για συνεπή authorization.

questions.answer_en: Authentication using two or more independent factor categories, e.g. knowledge, possession and inherence.
questions.answer_el: Authentication με δύο ή περισσότερες ανεξάρτητες κατηγορίες factors, π.χ. knowledge, possession, inherence.

questions.answer_en: Hashing is designed to be one-way and produces a digest; encryption is reversible with the correct key and protects confidentiality.
questions.answer_el: Hashing είναι σχεδιασμένο ως one-way και παράγει digest· encryption είναι reversible με σωστό key και προστατεύει confidentiality.

questions.answer_en: Symmetric uses the same secret key to encrypt/decrypt; asymmetric uses a public/private key pair.
questions.answer_el: Symmetric χρησιμοποιεί ίδιο secret key για encrypt/decrypt· asymmetric public/private key pair.

questions.answer_en: TLS secures network communication with encryption, integrity and endpoint authentication; HTTPS is HTTP over TLS.
questions.answer_el: TLS ασφαλίζει network communication με encryption, integrity και endpoint authentication· HTTPS είναι HTTP πάνω από TLS.

questions.question_en: What does a digital certificate do?
questions.answer_en: It binds an identity such as a hostname to a public key through a certificate authority's signature, enabling authenticated TLS/public-key use.
questions.answer_el: Συνδέει identity όπως hostname με public key μέσω signature Certificate Authority, επιτρέποντας authenticated TLS/public-key χρήση.

questions.answer_en: Injection of attacker-controlled SQL syntax through unsafe query construction.
questions.answer_el: Εισαγωγή attacker-controlled SQL syntax μέσω unsafe query construction.

questions.question_en: Give an example of vulnerable SQL.
questions.answer_en: Building SQL such as "... WHERE username='" + userInput + "'" is vulnerable because input becomes SQL syntax; use bind variables instead.
questions.answer_el: SQL όπως "... WHERE username='" + userInput + "'" είναι vulnerable επειδή input γίνεται SQL syntax· χρησιμοποιήστε bind variables.

questions.question_en: How do parameterized queries prevent SQL injection?
questions.question_el: Πώς αποτρέπουν SQL injection τα parameterized queries;
questions.answer_en: They send code structure and data values separately, so malicious characters remain data rather than SQL operators.
questions.answer_el: Στέλνουν code structure και data values ξεχωριστά, ώστε malicious characters να παραμένουν data και όχι SQL operators.

questions.answer_en: Cross-Site Scripting occurs when untrusted content executes as script in another user's browser.
questions.answer_el: Cross-Site Scripting συμβαίνει όταν untrusted content εκτελείται ως script στον browser άλλου χρήστη.

questions.answer_en: Stored XSS is persisted by the application and served later; reflected XSS comes from a request and is immediately reflected into an unsafe response.
questions.answer_el: Stored XSS αποθηκεύεται και σερβίρεται αργότερα· reflected XSS προέρχεται από request και αντανακλάται άμεσα σε unsafe response.

questions.answer_en: An attack that tricks an authenticated browser into issuing an unwanted state-changing request to a site where the user is logged in.
questions.answer_el: Attack που ξεγελά authenticated browser να στείλει ανεπιθύμητο state-changing request σε site όπου ο user είναι logged in.

questions.answer_en: Use anti-CSRF tokens, appropriate SameSite cookies, origin/referrer validation and do not perform state changes with safe GET requests.
questions.answer_el: Με anti-CSRF tokens, κατάλληλα SameSite cookies, origin/referrer validation και χωρίς state changes μέσω GET.

questions.answer_en: Taking over a valid user's authenticated session, usually by stealing or predicting session credentials/tokens.
questions.answer_el: Κατάληψη authenticated session έγκυρου user, συνήθως με κλοπή ή πρόβλεψη session credentials/tokens.

questions.question_en: Why use HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite cookie settings?
questions.question_el: Γιατί χρησιμοποιούμε HttpOnly, Secure και SameSite στα cookies;
questions.answer_en: HttpOnly reduces script access, Secure limits transmission to HTTPS, and SameSite restricts cross-site sending to mitigate CSRF in supported scenarios.
questions.answer_el: HttpOnly μειώνει script access, Secure περιορίζει σε HTTPS και SameSite περιορίζει cross-site sending για mitigation CSRF.

questions.question_en: Why should passwords never be stored in plaintext?
questions.question_el: Γιατί δεν αποθηκεύουμε passwords σε plaintext;
questions.answer_en: A data breach would reveal every password immediately and expose users wherever passwords are reused.
questions.answer_el: Σε breach αποκαλύπτονται άμεσα όλα τα passwords και εκτίθενται users όπου έχουν reuse.

questions.answer_en: Adding a unique random salt to each password before slow password hashing so identical passwords do not produce identical stored hashes.
questions.answer_el: Προσθήκη unique random salt σε κάθε password πριν από slow password hashing ώστε ίδια passwords να μην έχουν ίδιο stored hash.

questions.question_en: Why should passwords not simply be encrypted?
questions.question_el: Γιατί τα passwords δεν πρέπει απλώς να κρυπτογραφούνται;
questions.answer_en: Authentication normally needs verification, not recovery of plaintext. Encryption creates a decryption key whose compromise exposes all passwords; use purpose-built password hashing.
questions.answer_el: Το authentication χρειάζεται verification, όχι ανάκτηση plaintext. Encryption δημιουργεί decryption key που αν διαρρεύσει εκθέτει όλα τα passwords· χρησιμοποιήστε password hashing.

questions.answer_en: Checking that data conforms to expected type, length, format, range and business rules before use.
questions.answer_el: Έλεγχος ότι data τηρούν αναμενόμενο type, length, format, range και business rules.

questions.answer_en: Allowlisting accepts only defined valid inputs; blocklisting rejects known bad patterns. Allowlisting is generally stronger where a valid domain can be defined.
questions.answer_el: Allowlisting δέχεται μόνο ορισμένα valid inputs· blocklisting απορρίπτει γνωστά bad patterns. Allowlisting είναι γενικά ισχυρότερο όταν το valid domain ορίζεται.

questions.answer_en: Recording security/business-relevant actions so actor, time, target, action and outcome can be traced.
questions.answer_el: Καταγραφή security/business-relevant actions ώστε actor, time, target, action και outcome να είναι traceable.

questions.question_en: What should an enterprise application audit?
questions.question_el: Τι πρέπει να κάνει audit μια enterprise application;
questions.answer_en: Authentication events, role/privilege changes, sensitive data actions, create/update/delete, approvals, configuration/admin actions and important integration events.
questions.answer_el: Authentication events, role/privilege changes, sensitive data actions, create/update/delete, approvals, configuration/admin actions και σημαντικά integration events.

questions.question_en: Why should sensitive information not appear in logs?
questions.question_el: Γιατί δεν πρέπει sensitive information να εμφανίζεται στα logs;
questions.answer_en: Logs are copied and broadly accessed operationally; secrets or unnecessary personal data increase breach impact and compliance exposure.
questions.answer_el: Τα logs αντιγράφονται και έχουν ευρύτερη operational πρόσβαση· secrets ή περιττά personal data αυξάνουν breach impact και compliance exposure.

questions.answer_en: The continuous process of discovering, assessing, prioritizing, remediating and verifying security weaknesses.
questions.answer_el: Συνεχής διαδικασία discovery, assessment, prioritization, remediation και verification security weaknesses.

questions.answer_en: Controlled identification, risk assessment, testing, deployment and verification of software updates and security fixes.
questions.answer_el: Ελεγχόμενο identification, risk assessment, testing, deployment και verification software updates/security fixes.

questions.answer_en: Backup creates recoverable copies of data/configuration; recovery restores service/data to an acceptable state after failure or loss.
questions.answer_el: Backup δημιουργεί recoverable copies data/configuration· recovery επαναφέρει service/data σε αποδεκτή κατάσταση μετά failure/loss.

questions.answer_en: Plans, technology and procedures for restoring critical IT services after a major site/system disruption.
questions.answer_el: Plans, technology και procedures για restoration critical IT services μετά από major site/system disruption.

questions.answer_en: RPO is maximum acceptable data loss measured in time; RTO is target time to restore service.
questions.answer_el: RPO είναι μέγιστη αποδεκτή απώλεια data σε χρόνο· RTO ο target χρόνος restoration service.

questions.question_en: How would you secure a web application containing student personal information?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα ασφαλίζατε web application με student personal information;
questions.answer_en: Use strong authentication, RBAC/least privilege, TLS, secure sessions, parameterized SQL, output encoding, CSRF defenses, data minimization, audit, secure secrets, patching, backups, monitoring and security testing.
questions.answer_el: Με strong authentication, RBAC/least privilege, TLS, secure sessions, parameterized SQL, output encoding, CSRF defenses, data minimization, audit, secure secrets, patching, backups, monitoring και security testing.

questions.question_en: How would you handle a suspected compromise of an application?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα χειριζόσασταν suspected compromise εφαρμογής;
questions.answer_en: Follow incident response: preserve evidence, contain, establish scope, revoke/rotate compromised access, eradicate cause, restore safely, validate, communicate appropriately and perform lessons-learned remediation.
questions.answer_el: Ακολουθήστε incident response: preserve evidence, contain, scope, revoke/rotate compromised access, eradicate cause, safe restore, validation, appropriate communication και lessons-learned remediation.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy explicitly requires correct, uninterrupted operation, performance and quality of service.

questions.answer_en: Designing and operating a service to minimize downtime through redundancy, health checks, failover and resilient procedures.
questions.answer_el: Σχεδιασμός/λειτουργία service για ελαχιστοποίηση downtime μέσω redundancy, health checks, failover και resilient procedures.

questions.answer_en: Availability is the proportion of time service is usable; reliability is the likelihood of correct failure-free operation over a period.
questions.answer_el: Availability είναι το ποσοστό χρόνου που service είναι usable· reliability η πιθανότητα σωστής failure-free λειτουργίας σε περίοδο.

questions.question_en: What is a single point of failure?
questions.question_el: Τι είναι single point of failure;
questions.answer_en: A component whose failure can make the whole service unavailable because no redundant path exists.
questions.answer_el: Component του οποίου failure μπορεί να ρίξει όλο το service επειδή δεν υπάρχει redundant path.

questions.answer_en: Providing duplicate/alternative components, paths or data so service can continue when one fails.
questions.answer_el: Παροχή duplicate/alternative components, paths ή data ώστε το service να συνεχίζει όταν ένα αποτύχει.

questions.answer_en: Switching workload from an unhealthy component to a standby or healthy alternative.
questions.answer_el: Μεταφορά workload από unhealthy component σε standby ή healthy alternative.

questions.answer_en: Distributing traffic/work across multiple healthy instances to improve capacity and resilience.
questions.answer_el: Κατανομή traffic/work σε πολλαπλά healthy instances για capacity και resilience.

questions.answer_en: Continuous measurement of health, availability, latency, errors, throughput and dependencies so failures/degradation are detected.
questions.answer_el: Συνεχής μέτρηση health, availability, latency, errors, throughput και dependencies για detection failures/degradation.

questions.answer_en: Availability, response latency, request throughput, error rate, CPU, memory, storage/I/O, database connections/waits, queue depth and key business transaction success.
questions.answer_el: Availability, response latency, throughput, error rate, CPU, memory, storage/I/O, database connections/waits, queue depth και key business transaction success.

questions.question_en: Why monitor CPU, memory, database connections, latency, error rate and disk usage?
questions.question_el: Γιατί παρακολουθούμε CPU, memory, database connections, latency, error rate και disk usage;
questions.answer_en: Together they reveal resource saturation, leaks, capacity limits, dependency issues and user-visible degradation before or during incidents.
questions.answer_el: Μαζί αποκαλύπτουν resource saturation, leaks, capacity limits, dependency issues και user-visible degradation πριν ή κατά incidents.

questions.answer_en: Recording structured events and diagnostic context produced by application execution.
questions.answer_el: Καταγραφή structured events και diagnostic context από την εκτέλεση application.

questions.answer_en: Logs are detailed discrete events; metrics are numeric time-series measurements suited to dashboards, trends and alerts.
questions.answer_el: Logs είναι λεπτομερή discrete events· metrics numeric time-series measurements για dashboards, trends και alerts.

questions.answer_en: A service agreement defining measurable commitments such as availability and support response/resolution targets.
questions.answer_el: Service agreement με measurable commitments όπως availability και support response/resolution targets.

questions.answer_en: An unplanned interruption, degradation or security/operational event affecting a service or its expected behavior.
questions.answer_el: Unplanned interruption, degradation ή security/operational event που επηρεάζει service ή expected behavior.

questions.answer_en: The coordinated process of detection, triage, ownership, communication, containment/workaround, restoration and closure of incidents.
questions.answer_el: Συντονισμένη διαδικασία detection, triage, ownership, communication, containment/workaround, restoration και closure incidents.

questions.answer_en: A structured investigation into underlying causes and contributing factors so recurrence can be reduced.
questions.answer_el: Δομημένη investigation underlying causes και contributing factors ώστε να μειωθεί recurrence.

questions.answer_en: A documented review of timeline, impact, causes, response effectiveness and corrective actions after an incident.
questions.answer_el: Τεκμηριωμένο review timeline, impact, causes, response effectiveness και corrective actions μετά incident.

questions.question_en: How would you investigate an application reported as slow?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα διερευνούσατε εφαρμογή που αναφέρεται ως slow;
questions.answer_en: Define scope/time, reproduce/measure end-to-end latency, inspect application/database/network/dependency telemetry, recent changes and slow traces, then isolate and verify the bottleneck.
questions.answer_el: Ορίστε scope/time, reproduce/measure end-to-end latency, ελέγξτε app/database/network/dependency telemetry, recent changes και slow traces, απομονώστε και επαληθεύστε bottleneck.

questions.question_en: How do you distinguish database, application and network performance problems?
questions.question_el: Πώς διακρίνετε database, application και network performance problems;
questions.answer_en: Use timing at each layer: DB query duration/waits, application processing traces/resources and network latency/errors. Correlate the slow interval rather than guessing.
questions.answer_el: Με timing ανά layer: DB query duration/waits, application traces/resources και network latency/errors. Κάντε correlation στο slow interval αντί guessing.

questions.question_en: What should happen when an application dependency becomes unavailable?
questions.question_el: Τι πρέπει να συμβαίνει όταν dependency εφαρμογής δεν είναι διαθέσιμο;
questions.answer_en: Fail predictably: bounded timeouts, safe retries/backoff, circuit breaking or queues where appropriate, graceful error messages, monitoring and recovery/reconciliation.
questions.answer_el: Predictable failure: bounded timeouts, safe retries/backoff, circuit breaking ή queues όπου ταιριάζει, graceful errors, monitoring και recovery/reconciliation.

questions.question_en: Why are backups not enough without restore testing?
questions.question_el: Γιατί backups δεν αρκούν χωρίς restore testing;
questions.answer_en: Only restore tests prove backups are complete, readable, correctly protected and recoverable within required RPO/RTO.
questions.answer_el: Μόνο restore tests αποδεικνύουν ότι backups είναι complete, readable, σωστά protected και recoverable εντός RPO/RTO.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy explicitly requires testing, functional evaluation and correct delivery.

questions.question_el: Γιατί είναι απαραίτητο το software testing;
questions.answer_en: It provides evidence that requirements are met, detects defects early, reduces operational risk and supports release decisions.
questions.answer_el: Παρέχει evidence ότι requirements ικανοποιούνται, εντοπίζει defects νωρίς, μειώνει operational risk και υποστηρίζει release decisions.

questions.answer_en: Testing a small unit of code, such as a function or class, in relative isolation.
questions.answer_el: Testing μικρής μονάδας κώδικα, όπως function ή class, σε σχετική απομόνωση.

questions.answer_en: Testing whether components, databases, APIs or external systems work correctly together.
questions.answer_el: Testing αν components, databases, APIs ή external systems συνεργάζονται σωστά.

questions.answer_en: Testing the complete integrated system against functional and non-functional requirements.
questions.answer_el: Testing ολόκληρου integrated system έναντι functional και non-functional requirements.

questions.answer_en: Validation by representative business users or stakeholders that the system supports real business needs and agreed acceptance criteria.
questions.answer_el: Validation από representative business users/stakeholders ότι το system καλύπτει business needs και acceptance criteria.

questions.answer_en: Re-testing existing behavior after changes to ensure previously working functionality has not broken.
questions.answer_el: Re-testing υπάρχοντος behavior μετά changes ώστε να επιβεβαιωθεί ότι δεν έσπασε προηγούμενη functionality.

questions.answer_en: A small set of high-level checks confirming a build/deployment is basically viable before deeper testing.
questions.answer_el: Μικρό σύνολο high-level checks ότι build/deployment είναι βασικά λειτουργικό πριν deeper testing.

questions.answer_en: Testing response time, throughput, resource use and behavior under representative workloads.
questions.answer_el: Testing response time, throughput, resource use και behavior υπό representative workloads.

questions.answer_en: Performance testing under expected and peak planned workload to verify capacity and service targets.
questions.answer_el: Performance testing σε expected/peak planned workload για capacity και service targets.

questions.answer_en: Load tests planned workload; stress testing exceeds normal capacity to find limits and observe failure/recovery behavior.
questions.answer_el: Load tests planned workload· stress testing υπερβαίνει normal capacity για limits και failure/recovery behavior.

questions.answer_en: Testing controls and behavior for vulnerabilities, authentication, authorization, input handling, configuration and other security requirements.
questions.answer_el: Testing controls/behavior για vulnerabilities, authentication, authorization, input handling, configuration και άλλα security requirements.

questions.answer_en: Functional verifies what the system does; non-functional verifies qualities such as performance, security, usability, accessibility and reliability.
questions.answer_el: Functional επαληθεύει τι κάνει το system· non-functional qualities όπως performance, security, usability, accessibility και reliability.

questions.answer_en: Black-box tests behavior from external inputs/outputs; white-box uses knowledge of internal code, branches and structures.
questions.answer_el: Black-box εξετάζει behavior από external inputs/outputs· white-box χρησιμοποιεί γνώση internal code, branches και structures.

questions.answer_en: A defined test with preconditions, inputs, steps and expected result used to verify a requirement or behavior.
questions.answer_el: Καθορισμένο test με preconditions, inputs, steps και expected result για verification requirement/behavior.

questions.question_en: What should a test case contain?
questions.question_el: Τι πρέπει να περιέχει test case;
questions.answer_en: ID, objective/requirement, preconditions, data, steps, expected result, actual result, status and evidence/notes as needed.
questions.answer_el: ID, objective/requirement, preconditions, data, steps, expected result, actual result, status και evidence/notes όπου χρειάζεται.

questions.answer_en: A measure of what requirements, code paths, risks or scenarios are exercised by tests; high coverage alone does not prove quality.
questions.answer_el: Μέτρο του ποια requirements, code paths, risks ή scenarios καλύπτονται από tests· υψηλό coverage μόνο του δεν αποδεικνύει quality.

questions.answer_en: A difference between actual system behavior and the specified or reasonably expected behavior.
questions.answer_el: Διαφορά μεταξύ actual system behavior και specified ή reasonably expected behavior.

questions.answer_en: Severity is impact; priority is urgency/order of remediation. They are related but not identical.
questions.answer_el: Severity είναι impact· priority είναι urgency/order remediation. Σχετίζονται αλλά δεν είναι το ίδιο.

questions.answer_en: A controlled non-production environment with software, configuration, dependencies and data suitable for executing tests.
questions.answer_el: Ελεγχόμενο non-production environment με software, configuration, dependencies και data κατάλληλα για tests.

questions.question_en: Why should testing normally not occur directly in production?
questions.question_el: Γιατί testing συνήθως δεν γίνεται απευθείας σε production;
questions.answer_en: It can affect users, corrupt real data, trigger integrations or create security/compliance risks; production verification should be controlled and minimal.
questions.answer_el: Μπορεί να επηρεάσει users, να αλλοιώσει real data, να trigger integrations ή να δημιουργήσει security/compliance risks· production verification πρέπει να είναι controlled/minimal.

questions.answer_en: The inputs and records prepared to exercise normal, boundary, invalid and exceptional scenarios.
questions.answer_el: Inputs και records που προετοιμάζονται για normal, boundary, invalid και exceptional scenarios.

questions.question_en: How should personal/production data be handled in test environments?
questions.question_el: Πώς χειριζόμαστε personal/production data σε test environments;
questions.answer_en: Prefer synthetic data; if real data is necessary, minimize, mask/pseudonymize where appropriate and apply equivalent access/security controls.
questions.answer_el: Προτιμήστε synthetic data· αν χρειάζεται real data, κάντε minimization, masking/pseudonymization όπου ταιριάζει και equivalent security controls.

questions.question_en: What are positive and negative test cases?
questions.question_el: Τι είναι positive και negative test cases;
questions.answer_en: Positive cases use valid inputs/workflows; negative cases deliberately exercise invalid, unauthorized, boundary and error conditions.
questions.answer_el: Positive cases χρησιμοποιούν valid inputs/workflows· negative cases invalid, unauthorized, boundary και error conditions.

questions.question_en: Create test cases for a university login screen.
questions.question_el: Δημιουργήστε test cases για university login screen.
questions.answer_en: Cover valid login, invalid password/user, locked/disabled account, empty fields, rate limiting, MFA if used, session creation, logout, accessibility, secure error messaging and injection/XSS inputs.
questions.answer_el: Καλύψτε valid login, invalid password/user, locked account, empty fields, rate limiting, MFA, session creation/logout, accessibility, secure errors και injection/XSS inputs.

questions.question_en: Create test cases for course registration.
questions.question_el: Δημιουργήστε test cases για course registration.
questions.answer_en: Test eligible registration, duplicate attempt, prerequisites, capacity, timetable conflict, registration window, authorization, concurrent last-seat attempts, rollback on failure, audit and confirmation.
questions.answer_el: Test eligible registration, duplicate, prerequisites, capacity, timetable conflict, registration window, authorization, concurrent last-seat attempts, rollback, audit και confirmation.

questions.question_en: How would you test an API?
questions.answer_en: Test authentication/authorization, schema/input validation, success and error responses, status codes, boundaries, idempotency, concurrency, performance, security and dependency failures.
questions.answer_el: Test authentication/authorization, schema/input validation, success/error responses, status codes, boundaries, idempotency, concurrency, performance, security και dependency failures.

questions.question_en: How would you test database changes?
questions.answer_en: Test migration, data integrity/constraints, query correctness, performance, locking, application compatibility, representative volumes and recovery/rollback strategy.
questions.answer_el: Test migration, integrity/constraints, query correctness, performance, locking, application compatibility, representative volumes και recovery/rollback strategy.

questions.question_en: What testing should happen before an application upgrade goes live?
questions.question_el: Τι testing πρέπει να γίνει πριν application upgrade πάει live;
questions.answer_en: Compatibility, regression, integrations, migration, security, performance, accessibility, UAT, backup/restore and rollback rehearsal, deployment and monitoring checks.
questions.answer_el: Compatibility, regression, integrations, migration, security, performance, accessibility, UAT, backup/restore και rollback rehearsal, deployment και monitoring checks.

topics.source_basis: Accessibility is explicitly mentioned in the vacancy.

questions.answer_en: Designing digital services so people with disabilities can perceive, understand, navigate and interact effectively.
questions.answer_el: Σχεδιασμός digital services ώστε άτομα με disabilities να μπορούν να αντιλαμβάνονται, κατανοούν, πλοηγούνται και αλληλεπιδρούν αποτελεσματικά.

questions.question_en: Why is accessibility important for a university system?
questions.question_el: Γιατί είναι σημαντική accessibility σε university system;
questions.answer_en: Universities serve diverse students/staff and essential processes; accessible systems improve equal access, usability and compliance with applicable obligations.
questions.answer_el: Τα πανεπιστήμια εξυπηρετούν diverse students/staff και essential processes· accessible systems βελτιώνουν equal access, usability και compliance.

questions.answer_en: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable and Robust (POUR).
questions.answer_el: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable και Robust (POUR).

questions.question_en: Explain Perceivable, Operable, Understandable and Robust.
questions.question_el: Εξηγήστε Perceivable, Operable, Understandable και Robust.
questions.answer_en: Perceivable: information can be sensed; Operable: controls can be used; Understandable: content/behavior is clear; Robust: works reliably with browsers and assistive technologies.
questions.answer_el: Perceivable: η πληροφορία γίνεται αντιληπτή, Operable: τα controls χρησιμοποιούνται, Understandable: content/behavior είναι σαφή, Robust: λειτουργεί αξιόπιστα με browsers/assistive technologies.

questions.question_en: Why should images have alternative text?
questions.question_el: Γιατί οι εικόνες πρέπει να έχουν alternative text;
questions.answer_en: Meaningful images need text alternatives so non-visual users receive equivalent information; decorative images should usually be ignored by assistive technology.
questions.answer_el: Meaningful images χρειάζονται text alternatives για equivalent information σε non-visual users· decorative images συνήθως αγνοούνται από assistive technology.

questions.answer_en: Users who cannot use a mouse need all interactive functionality reachable and operable by keyboard with logical focus order.
questions.answer_el: Users που δεν μπορούν mouse χρειάζονται όλη την interactive functionality reachable/operable με keyboard και logical focus order.

questions.answer_en: Text and essential visual information must have enough luminance contrast against backgrounds to meet the applicable WCAG criterion/level.
questions.answer_el: Text και essential visual information πρέπει να έχουν επαρκές luminance contrast με background σύμφωνα με applicable WCAG criterion/level.

questions.question_en: Why should form fields have labels?
questions.question_el: Γιατί form fields πρέπει να έχουν labels;
questions.answer_en: Programmatically associated labels communicate purpose to screen readers and improve usability for all users.
questions.answer_el: Programmatically associated labels μεταδίδουν purpose σε screen readers και βελτιώνουν usability για όλους.

questions.question_en: Why should color alone not communicate information?
questions.question_el: Γιατί το color μόνο του δεν πρέπει να μεταδίδει information;
questions.answer_en: Some users cannot distinguish colors and non-visual interfaces do not perceive them; add text, icons or another cue.
questions.answer_el: Κάποιοι users δεν διακρίνουν colors και non-visual interfaces δεν τα αντιλαμβάνονται· προσθέστε text, icons ή άλλο cue.

questions.answer_en: Elements whose markup conveys meaning/role, such as headings, buttons, labels, nav and tables, helping structure and assistive technologies.
questions.answer_el: Elements των οποίων το markup μεταδίδει meaning/role, όπως headings, buttons, labels, nav και tables.

questions.question_en: How do screen readers work conceptually?
questions.answer_en: They expose text and accessibility-tree semantics through speech or braille, relying on correct structure, names, roles and states.
questions.answer_el: Εκθέτουν text και accessibility-tree semantics μέσω speech ή braille, βασιζόμενα σε σωστά structure, names, roles και states.

questions.answer_en: Accessible Rich Internet Applications attributes communicate roles, states and relationships when native HTML semantics are insufficient.
questions.answer_el: Accessible Rich Internet Applications attributes που μεταδίδουν roles, states και relationships όταν native HTML semantics δεν αρκούν.

questions.answer_en: Prefer native semantic HTML; use ARIA only when needed to represent custom widget semantics/states that native elements cannot express.
questions.answer_el: Προτιμήστε native semantic HTML· ARIA μόνο όταν χρειάζεται για custom widget semantics/states που native elements δεν εκφράζουν.

questions.question_en: How would you test a web application for accessibility?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα δοκιμάζατε web application για accessibility;
questions.answer_en: Combine automated scans with keyboard-only testing, screen-reader checks, labels/semantics, focus, contrast, zoom/reflow and applicable WCAG success criteria.
questions.answer_el: Συνδυάστε automated scans με keyboard-only testing, screen-reader checks, labels/semantics, focus, contrast, zoom/reflow και applicable WCAG criteria.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy includes technical support, training and user documentation.

questions.answer_en: Accuracy, clear audience/scope, structure, examples, versioning, searchability, maintainability and actionable troubleshooting.
questions.answer_el: Accuracy, σαφές audience/scope, structure, examples, versioning, searchability, maintainability και actionable troubleshooting.

questions.answer_en: User docs explain tasks/features; technical docs explain architecture, APIs, data, configuration, deployment and support internals.
questions.answer_el: User docs εξηγούν tasks/features· technical docs architecture, APIs, data, configuration, deployment και support internals.

questions.question_en: What should a user manual contain?
questions.question_el: Τι πρέπει να περιέχει user manual;
questions.answer_en: Purpose/audience, access/prerequisites, common workflows, clear steps, errors/FAQ, support route and version/date.
questions.answer_el: Purpose/audience, access/prerequisites, common workflows, clear steps, errors/FAQ, support route και version/date.

questions.question_en: How would you document an API?
questions.answer_en: Describe authentication, endpoints, methods, request/response schemas, examples, status/error codes, limits, idempotency, versioning and change policy.
questions.answer_el: Authentication, endpoints, methods, request/response schemas, examples, status/error codes, limits, idempotency, versioning και change policy.

questions.question_en: How would you document a database?
questions.answer_en: ER/data model, table/column definitions, keys/relationships, constraints, ownership, sensitive classifications, indexes, retention, important procedures and integration dependencies.
questions.answer_el: ER/data model, table/column definitions, keys/relationships, constraints, ownership, sensitive classifications, indexes, retention, procedures και integration dependencies.

questions.question_en: What should an application support procedure contain?
questions.question_el: Τι πρέπει να περιέχει application support procedure;
questions.answer_en: Scope, ownership, contact/escalation, severity levels, diagnostics, common fixes, access rules, change procedure, recovery steps, SLA and communication guidance.
questions.answer_el: Scope, ownership, contact/escalation, severity levels, diagnostics, common fixes, access rules, change procedure, recovery steps, SLA και communication guidance.

questions.question_en: What information should be collected from a user reporting a problem?
questions.question_el: Τι πληροφορίες συλλέγουμε από user που αναφέρει πρόβλημα;
questions.answer_en: Who/where/when, exact steps, expected vs actual behavior, error text, affected records, frequency, business impact, screenshots and reproducibility.
questions.answer_el: Who/where/when, exact steps, expected vs actual behavior, error text, affected records, frequency, business impact, screenshots και reproducibility.

questions.question_en: How would you prioritize support incidents?
questions.answer_en: Use impact and urgency: users/process criticality, security/data risk, workaround, deadlines and SLA commitments.
questions.answer_el: Με impact και urgency: users/process criticality, security/data risk, workaround, deadlines και SLA commitments.

questions.question_en: How do you communicate a technical issue to a non-technical user?
questions.question_el: Πώς επικοινωνείτε technical issue σε non-technical user;
questions.answer_en: Explain user impact, what is known, safe workaround and next actions in plain language; avoid unnecessary jargon and speculation.
questions.answer_el: Εξηγήστε user impact, known facts, safe workaround και next actions σε plain language· αποφύγετε jargon/speculation.

questions.question_en: How would you train university administrative staff on a new application?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα εκπαιδεύατε administrative staff σε νέα application;
questions.answer_en: Map roles/workflows, teach scenario-based tasks, provide hands-on practice and guides, cover errors/support, gather feedback and reinforce after launch.
questions.answer_el: Χαρτογραφήστε roles/workflows, scenario-based tasks, hands-on practice/guides, errors/support, feedback και reinforcement μετά launch.

questions.question_en: How would you determine whether training was successful?
questions.question_el: Πώς διαπιστώνετε αν training ήταν επιτυχές;
questions.answer_en: Measure task completion, exercises, user confidence/feedback, error/support trends and adoption against learning objectives.
questions.answer_el: Μετρήστε task completion, exercises, user confidence/feedback, error/support trends και adoption έναντι learning objectives.

topics.source_basis: The vacancy includes vendor collaboration and techno-economic studies for software development, procurement and upgrades.

questions.question_en: Build versus buy: what factors should be considered?
questions.question_el: Build έναντι buy: ποιοι παράγοντες πρέπει να εξεταστούν;
questions.answer_en: Functional fit, strategic value, implementation time, skills, total cost, integration, security, customization, maintainability, vendor viability, support, compliance, lock-in and exit options.
questions.answer_el: Functional fit, strategic value, implementation time, skills, total cost, integration, security, customization, maintainability, vendor viability, support, compliance, lock-in και exit options.

questions.question_en: What is Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)?
questions.question_el: Τι είναι Total Cost of Ownership (TCO);
questions.answer_en: The full lifecycle cost of a solution, including purchase/licensing, implementation, infrastructure, integration, migration, support, maintenance, staffing, training, upgrades and retirement.
questions.answer_el: Το συνολικό lifecycle cost μιας λύσης, με purchase/licensing, implementation, infrastructure, integration, migration, support, maintenance, staffing, training, upgrades και retirement.

questions.answer_en: CAPEX is capital expenditure associated with acquiring/improving long-lived assets; OPEX is ongoing operating expenditure. Exact accounting treatment depends on applicable rules.
questions.answer_el: CAPEX είναι capital expenditure για acquiring/improving long-lived assets· OPEX ongoing operating expenditure. Το ακριβές accounting treatment εξαρτάται από applicable rules.

questions.question_en: What costs should be included when evaluating software?
questions.question_el: Ποια κόστη πρέπει να περιλαμβάνονται στην αξιολόγηση software;
questions.answer_en: Licensing/subscription, implementation, customization, infrastructure, integration, data migration, training, support, maintenance, upgrades, security/compliance, internal staffing and exit costs.
questions.answer_el: Licensing/subscription, implementation, customization, infrastructure, integration, data migration, training, support, maintenance, upgrades, security/compliance, internal staffing και exit costs.

questions.question_en: Why consider licensing, implementation, migration, infrastructure, training, support, maintenance and upgrade costs together?
questions.question_el: Γιατί εξετάζουμε μαζί licensing, implementation, migration, infrastructure, training, support, maintenance και upgrade costs;
questions.answer_en: Because acquisition price alone does not represent lifecycle cost; recurring and implementation expenses may dominate long-term TCO.
questions.answer_el: Επειδή acquisition price μόνο δεν αντιπροσωπεύει lifecycle cost· recurring και implementation expenses μπορεί να κυριαρχούν στο TCO.

questions.answer_en: Criteria measuring whether the product supports required business capabilities, workflows, reports, rules and user roles.
questions.answer_el: Criteria που μετρούν αν product υποστηρίζει required business capabilities, workflows, reports, rules και user roles.

questions.answer_en: Architecture, database/platform compatibility, APIs, integration, deployment, security, performance, scalability, maintainability, monitoring, backup/recovery and supportability.
questions.answer_el: Architecture, database/platform compatibility, APIs, integration, deployment, security, performance, scalability, maintainability, monitoring, backup/recovery και supportability.

questions.answer_en: Quality attributes such as performance, availability, security, accessibility, usability, maintainability, scalability and compliance.
questions.answer_el: Quality attributes όπως performance, availability, security, accessibility, usability, maintainability, scalability και compliance.

questions.question_en: How should competing software products be evaluated objectively?
questions.question_el: Πώς αξιολογούνται αντικειμενικά competing software products;
questions.answer_en: Define mandatory and weighted criteria before evaluation, gather comparable evidence, score consistently, document assumptions/risks and separate technical evidence from preference.
questions.answer_el: Ορίστε mandatory και weighted criteria πριν evaluation, συγκεντρώστε comparable evidence, score consistently, καταγράψτε assumptions/risks και διαχωρίστε technical evidence από preference.

questions.question_en: What is a weighted scoring model?
questions.answer_en: A comparison method assigning importance weights to criteria and scores to alternatives, then calculating weighted totals while retaining qualitative risk review.
questions.answer_el: Μέθοδος comparison με weights στα criteria και scores στις alternatives, υπολογίζοντας weighted totals μαζί με qualitative risk review.

questions.answer_en: Dependence on a supplier/technology that makes migration difficult or costly because of proprietary formats, integrations, contracts, customizations or skills.
questions.answer_el: Εξάρτηση από supplier/technology που κάνει migration δύσκολο/ακριβό λόγω proprietary formats, integrations, contracts, customizations ή skills.

questions.question_en: What risks arise from vendor lock-in?
questions.question_el: Ποιοι κίνδυνοι προκύπτουν από vendor lock-in;
questions.answer_en: Higher switching cost, weaker negotiating leverage, dependence on vendor roadmap/pricing/support and difficult data/application portability.
questions.answer_el: Μεγαλύτερο switching cost, ασθενέστερο negotiating leverage, εξάρτηση από vendor roadmap/pricing/support και δύσκολη portability data/application.

questions.answer_en: A contract or agreement defining measurable service commitments and responsibilities.
questions.answer_el: Contract/agreement που ορίζει measurable service commitments και responsibilities.

questions.question_en: What should you evaluate in a vendor support SLA?
questions.question_el: Τι αξιολογείτε σε vendor support SLA;
questions.answer_en: Availability, support hours, severity definitions, response/resolution targets, escalation, maintenance, security obligations, reporting, recovery and remedies/service credits.
questions.answer_el: Availability, support hours, severity definitions, response/resolution targets, escalation, maintenance, security obligations, reporting, recovery και remedies/service credits.

questions.answer_en: The legal terms defining how software may be installed, accessed, copied, modified or used and how fees are calculated.
questions.answer_el: Οι legal terms που καθορίζουν πώς software μπορεί να installed, accessed, copied, modified ή used και πώς υπολογίζονται fees.

questions.answer_en: SaaS is operated by a provider and accessed as a service; on-premises is deployed/operated primarily in the organization's own infrastructure or controlled environment.
questions.answer_el: SaaS λειτουργεί από provider και προσπελαύνεται ως service· on-premises deployed/operated κυρίως σε οργανωτική infrastructure/controlled environment.

questions.question_en: What are benefits and disadvantages of SaaS?
questions.question_el: Ποια είναι πλεονεκτήματα και μειονεκτήματα SaaS;
questions.answer_en: Benefits include faster deployment, provider-managed infrastructure/updates and scalable subscription service. Risks include recurring cost, provider dependency, data residency/security constraints, integration limits and lock-in.
questions.answer_el: Benefits: faster deployment, provider-managed infrastructure/updates, scalable subscription. Risks: recurring cost, provider dependency, data residency/security constraints, integration limits και lock-in.

questions.question_en: What technical risks should be considered before upgrading enterprise software?
questions.question_el: Ποιοι technical risks εξετάζονται πριν enterprise software upgrade;
questions.answer_en: Compatibility, customizations, database/schema migration, integrations, security changes, performance regression, downtime, unsupported dependencies and rollback feasibility.
questions.answer_el: Compatibility, customizations, database/schema migration, integrations, security changes, performance regression, downtime, unsupported dependencies και rollback feasibility.

questions.question_en: How would you plan migration from an old system to a new one?
questions.question_el: Πώς σχεδιάζετε migration από παλιό σε νέο system;
questions.answer_en: Inventory data/integrations, define mappings and cleansing, migration tooling, rehearsals, reconciliation, cutover, backup/rollback, UAT, communication, support and post-cutover verification.
questions.answer_el: Inventory data/integrations, mappings/cleansing, migration tooling, rehearsals, reconciliation, cutover, backup/rollback, UAT, communication, support και post-cutover verification.

questions.answer_en: The controlled transfer and transformation of data from a source system/schema to a target system/schema.
questions.answer_el: Η ελεγχόμενη μεταφορά και transformation data από source system/schema σε target system/schema.

questions.question_en: How would you validate migrated data?
questions.answer_en: Compare record counts/totals, constraints, referential integrity, checksums where appropriate, source-target samples, exception reports and business reconciliation.
questions.answer_el: Συγκρίνετε record counts/totals, constraints, referential integrity, checksums όπου ταιριάζει, source-target samples, exception reports και business reconciliation.

questions.answer_en: Defining when and how to safely return to the previous known-good state, including data handling, backups, responsibilities, timing and validation.
questions.answer_el: Ορισμός του πότε/πώς γίνεται ασφαλής επιστροφή σε previous known-good state, με data handling, backups, responsibilities, timing και validation.

topics.source_basis: The written technical subject is explicitly tied to the duties and job description, making applied scenarios high-value preparation.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: how would you gather requirements?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: πώς θα συλλέγατε requirements;
questions.answer_en: Identify student, academic, administrative, finance, IT/security and decision-making stakeholders; review current process/policies/data; conduct interviews/workshops; document functional/non-functional requirements and validate them with acceptance criteria.
questions.answer_el: Εντοπίστε student, academic, administrative, finance, IT/security και decision stakeholders· αναλύστε current process/policies/data· interviews/workshops· τεκμηριώστε functional/non-functional requirements και validate με acceptance criteria.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: which stakeholders would you involve?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: ποιους stakeholders θα εμπλέκατε;
questions.answer_en: Applicants/students, scholarship administration, academic reviewers, finance, relevant management, IT/application support, security/privacy, accessibility representatives and any external integration owners.
questions.answer_el: Applicants/students, scholarship administration, academic reviewers, finance, management, IT/application support, security/privacy, accessibility representatives και external integration owners.

questions.answer_en: Authentication, eligibility/application submission, document upload, validation, status tracking, review/scoring, approvals, notifications, deadlines, reporting, audit and permitted corrections/withdrawals.
questions.answer_el: Authentication, eligibility/application submission, document upload, validation, status tracking, review/scoring, approvals, notifications, deadlines, reporting, audit και permitted corrections/withdrawals.

questions.answer_en: Security/privacy, accessibility, availability around deadlines, performance, auditability, retention, backup/recovery, maintainability, browser/device compatibility and integration reliability.
questions.answer_el: Security/privacy, accessibility, availability κοντά σε deadlines, performance, auditability, retention, backup/recovery, maintainability, browser/device compatibility και integration reliability.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: design a basic database schema.
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: σχεδιάστε basic database schema.
questions.answer_en: Core entities could include Applicant/Student, Scholarship, Application, ApplicationDocument metadata, Review, Reviewer, Decision, StatusHistory and Notification, with proper PK/FK/unique constraints.
questions.answer_el: Core entities: Applicant/Student, Scholarship, Application, ApplicationDocument metadata, Review, Reviewer, Decision, StatusHistory, Notification, με PK/FK/unique constraints.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: what security requirements would you specify?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: ποια security requirements θα ορίζατε;
questions.answer_en: Strong authentication, role-based least privilege, protected documents, TLS, secure sessions, parameterized queries, audit trails, secure upload validation, secrets management, retention/access rules and monitoring.
questions.answer_el: Strong authentication, RBAC least privilege, protected documents, TLS, secure sessions, parameterized queries, audit trails, secure upload validation, secrets management, retention/access rules και monitoring.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: what accessibility requirements would you specify?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: ποια accessibility requirements θα ορίζατε;
questions.answer_en: Applicable WCAG target, keyboard operation, semantic forms/labels, screen-reader compatibility, focus/error handling, contrast, reflow/zoom, accessible documents and tested user journeys.
questions.answer_el: Applicable WCAG target, keyboard operation, semantic forms/labels, screen-reader compatibility, focus/error handling, contrast, reflow/zoom, accessible documents και tested journeys.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: what testing would you perform?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: τι testing θα κάνατε;
questions.answer_en: Unit/integration/system/UAT plus security, accessibility, performance/load around deadlines, upload validation, permissions, workflow, notifications, backup/recovery and regression.
questions.answer_el: Unit/integration/system/UAT μαζί με security, accessibility, performance/load σε deadlines, upload validation, permissions, workflow, notifications, backup/recovery και regression.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: how would you integrate it with existing student systems?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: πώς θα το διασυνδέατε με existing student systems;
questions.answer_en: Use documented APIs/events where possible, establish authoritative identifiers/data ownership, secure authentication, validation/mapping, idempotency, error handling, reconciliation and monitoring.
questions.answer_el: Με documented APIs/events όπου γίνεται, authoritative identifiers/data ownership, secure authentication, validation/mapping, idempotency, error handling, reconciliation και monitoring.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: how would you train users?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: πώς θα εκπαιδεύατε users;
questions.answer_en: Segment training by role, demonstrate real workflows, provide hands-on exercises and concise guides, cover common errors/support and gather post-training feedback.
questions.answer_el: Χωρίστε training ανά role, δείξτε real workflows, hands-on exercises/guides, common errors/support και post-training feedback.

questions.question_en: Scholarship system: what documentation would you produce?
questions.question_el: Σύστημα υποτροφιών: τι documentation θα παράγατε;
questions.answer_en: Requirements/specification, architecture/data model, API/integration docs, security/access model, deployment/runbook, support/troubleshooting, test evidence, user guides and training material.
questions.answer_el: Requirements/specification, architecture/data model, API/integration docs, security/access model, deployment/runbook, support/troubleshooting, test evidence, user guides και training material.

questions.question_en: Slow Oracle APEX application: describe your troubleshooting process.
questions.question_el: Αργή Oracle APEX application: περιγράψτε troubleshooting process.
questions.answer_en: Confirm scope/timing, enable APEX debug, identify slow regions/processes, inspect SQL execution plans and waits, compare statistics/data growth/recent changes, check external calls and resources, fix the bottleneck and remeasure.
questions.answer_el: Επιβεβαιώστε scope/timing, APEX debug, slow regions/processes, SQL plans/waits, statistics/data growth/recent changes, external calls/resources, fix bottleneck και remeasure.

questions.question_en: Slow application: what application metrics would you inspect?
questions.question_el: Αργή εφαρμογή: ποια application metrics θα ελέγχατε;
questions.answer_en: Request latency percentiles, throughput, error rate, active requests/threads, pool usage, CPU/memory, external-call duration and slow transaction traces.
questions.answer_el: Request latency percentiles, throughput, error rate, active requests/threads, pool usage, CPU/memory, external-call duration και slow traces.

questions.question_en: Slow application: what database metrics would you inspect?
questions.question_el: Αργή εφαρμογή: ποια database metrics θα ελέγχατε;
questions.answer_en: Top SQL duration/CPU/I/O, waits, active sessions, blocking/locks, connection count, buffer/cache behavior, I/O, plan changes and resource utilization.
questions.answer_el: Top SQL duration/CPU/I/O, waits, active sessions, blocking/locks, connection count, buffer/cache behavior, I/O, plan changes και resource utilization.

questions.question_en: How would you identify slow SQL?
questions.answer_en: Use database performance views/tools and application traces to rank statements by elapsed time, executions, CPU/I/O or waits, then inspect representative execution plans.
questions.answer_el: Χρησιμοποιήστε database performance views/tools και application traces για ranking statements με elapsed time, executions, CPU/I/O ή waits και inspect plans.

questions.question_en: How would execution plans help with a slow query?
questions.question_el: Πώς βοηθούν execution plans σε slow query;
questions.answer_en: They reveal access paths, join methods/order, scans, sorts and estimated cardinalities so inefficient or misestimated steps can be identified.
questions.answer_el: Δείχνουν access paths, join methods/order, scans, sorts και estimated cardinalities ώστε να εντοπιστούν inefficient/misestimated steps.

questions.question_en: Could indexes help a slow query?
questions.question_el: Μπορούν indexes να βοηθήσουν slow query;
questions.answer_en: Yes if predicates/joins are selective and suitable; verify with plan and workload because an index can also add write/storage cost or be ignored.
questions.answer_el: Ναι αν predicates/joins είναι selective και suitable· επιβεβαιώστε με plan/workload επειδή index έχει write/storage cost ή μπορεί να αγνοηθεί.

questions.question_en: What other causes can make an APEX application slow?
questions.question_el: Ποιες άλλες αιτίες μπορεί να κάνουν APEX application slow;
questions.answer_en: External APIs, network latency, excessive page components, PL/SQL loops, locking, connection/resource saturation, browser assets, data growth or recent configuration/code changes.
