questions.answer_el: External APIs, network latency, excessive page components, PL/SQL loops, locking, connection/resource saturation, browser assets, data growth ή recent config/code changes.

questions.question_en: How would you confirm a performance fix worked?
questions.question_el: Πώς επιβεβαιώνετε ότι performance fix δούλεψε;
questions.answer_en: Repeat the same representative test, compare before/after latency/resource metrics and plans, test under expected load and monitor after release for regression.
questions.answer_el: Επαναλάβετε representative test, συγκρίνετε before/after latency/resource metrics και plans, test σε expected load και monitor μετά release.

questions.question_en: Unsafe SQL construction: identify the vulnerability.
questions.question_el: Unsafe SQL construction: εντοπίστε το vulnerability.
questions.answer_en: SQL injection, because untrusted input is being interpreted as part of executable SQL syntax.
questions.answer_el: SQL injection, επειδή untrusted input ερμηνεύεται ως μέρος executable SQL syntax.

questions.question_en: How could SQL injection be exploited conceptually?
questions.question_el: Πώς μπορεί να γίνει exploitation SQL injection εννοιολογικά;
questions.answer_en: An attacker crafts input that changes the intended query logic, potentially bypassing checks or performing unauthorized database actions depending on privileges.
questions.answer_el: Attacker δημιουργεί input που αλλάζει intended query logic, πιθανώς παρακάμπτοντας checks ή κάνοντας unauthorized database actions ανάλογα με privileges.

questions.question_en: What could an SQL-injection attacker potentially access?
questions.question_el: Τι μπορεί δυνητικά να προσπελάσει attacker μέσω SQL injection;
questions.answer_en: Any data/actions allowed by the database identity used by the application, which is why least privilege materially limits impact.
questions.answer_el: Data/actions που επιτρέπονται στο database identity της application, γι' αυτό least privilege περιορίζει ουσιαστικά impact.

questions.question_en: How would you fix SQL injection?
questions.answer_en: Replace string concatenation with parameterized SQL/bind variables, review dynamic SQL, validate inputs, apply least privilege and test affected paths.
questions.answer_el: Αντικαταστήστε concatenation με parameterized SQL/bind variables, review dynamic SQL, validate inputs, least privilege και test affected paths.

questions.question_en: What investigation should follow discovery of SQL injection?
questions.question_el: Τι investigation ακολουθεί discovery SQL injection;
questions.answer_en: Assess exposure window and affected endpoints, inspect logs/audit trails for suspicious requests or data access, preserve evidence, scope affected accounts/data and follow incident procedures.
questions.answer_el: Assess exposure window/endpoints, logs/audit trails για suspicious requests/data access, preserve evidence, scope affected accounts/data και incident procedures.

questions.question_en: What logs should be reviewed after suspected injection?
questions.question_el: Ποια logs πρέπει να ελεγχθούν μετά suspected injection;
questions.answer_en: Web/application request logs, authentication logs, database audit/query logs where available, WAF/proxy logs and system/security telemetry correlated by time and identifiers.
questions.answer_el: Web/application request logs, authentication logs, database audit/query logs όπου υπάρχουν, WAF/proxy logs και system/security telemetry με time/IDs correlation.

questions.question_en: Is changing vulnerable code alone sufficient after suspected exploitation?
questions.question_el: Αρκεί μόνο αλλαγή vulnerable code μετά suspected exploitation;
questions.answer_en: No. If exploitation may have occurred, investigate scope, contain/rotate compromised access, verify data/system integrity and complete incident-response actions in addition to fixing code.
questions.answer_el: Όχι. Αν πιθανόν έγινε exploitation, διερευνήστε scope, contain/rotate compromised access, verify data/system integrity και ολοκληρώστε incident response μαζί με code fix.

questions.question_en: System integration scenario: propose an architecture.
questions.answer_en: Use a versioned HTTPS API for request/response needs or a message/event layer for asynchronous workflows, with authentication, validation, canonical IDs, idempotency, retries, audit/reconciliation and monitoring.
questions.answer_el: Versioned HTTPS API για request/response ή message/event layer για async workflows, με authentication, validation, canonical IDs, idempotency, retries, audit/reconciliation και monitoring.

questions.question_en: REST API, database integration or file transfer: which would you choose and why?
questions.question_el: REST API, database integration ή file transfer: τι θα επιλέγατε και γιατί;
questions.answer_en: Usually prefer a documented API for controlled contracts and business rules; file transfer can suit batch exchange; direct database access is tightly coupled and should require strong justification.
questions.answer_el: Συνήθως documented API για controlled contracts/business rules· file transfer για batch exchange· direct database access είναι tightly coupled και θέλει ισχυρή justification.

questions.question_en: How would authentication work between integrated systems?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα λειτουργούσε authentication μεταξύ integrated systems;
questions.answer_en: Use service identities with managed credentials such as OAuth client credentials, mTLS or another approved mechanism; store/rotate secrets securely and authorize least privilege.
questions.answer_el: Με service identities και managed credentials όπως OAuth client credentials, mTLS ή άλλο approved mechanism· secure storage/rotation και least-privilege authorization.

questions.question_en: How would integration data be validated?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα γινόταν validation integration data;
questions.answer_en: Validate schema, required fields, types, ranges, identifiers and business rules at trust boundaries; reject invalid payloads with actionable errors.
questions.answer_el: Validate schema, required fields, types, ranges, identifiers και business rules στα trust boundaries· reject invalid payloads με actionable errors.

questions.question_en: How would integration failures be handled?
questions.answer_en: Classify transient versus permanent errors, use bounded retry/backoff for transient failures, dead-letter/manual handling for persistent failures, log/correlate and reconcile outcomes.
questions.answer_el: Classify transient/permanent errors, bounded retry/backoff για transient, dead-letter/manual handling για persistent, logging/correlation και reconciliation.

questions.answer_en: Retry only retryable failures with maximum attempts, exponential backoff/jitter and idempotency; stop or route for manual handling when limits are reached.
questions.answer_el: Retry μόνο retryable failures με max attempts, exponential backoff/jitter και idempotency· stop/manual handling όταν φτάσουν limits.

questions.answer_en: Use idempotency/request IDs, unique constraints and transactional deduplication so repeated delivery cannot repeat the business effect.
questions.answer_el: Με idempotency/request IDs, unique constraints και transactional deduplication ώστε repeated delivery να μη διπλασιάζει business effect.

questions.question_en: How would the integration be monitored?
questions.answer_en: Track throughput, success/failure rate, latency, queue depth/backlog, retries, dead letters, reconciliation differences and SLA breaches with correlation IDs and alerts.
questions.answer_el: Track throughput, success/failure, latency, queue depth/backlog, retries, dead letters, reconciliation differences και SLA breaches με correlation IDs/alerts.

questions.question_en: How would sensitive information be protected in integration?
questions.question_el: Πώς προστατεύεται sensitive information σε integration;
questions.answer_en: TLS in transit, strong authentication/authorization, data minimization, secure secrets, encryption where needed, safe logging, restricted retention and auditing.
questions.answer_el: TLS in transit, strong authentication/authorization, data minimization, secure secrets, encryption όπου χρειάζεται, safe logging, restricted retention και auditing.

questions.question_en: Production upgrade: how would you plan it?
questions.question_el: Production upgrade: πώς θα το σχεδιάζατε;
questions.answer_en: Define scope/success criteria, inventory dependencies, assess compatibility, rehearse non-production, test, back up, define cutover/rollback, communicate, monitor and validate after deployment.
questions.answer_el: Scope/success criteria, dependencies, compatibility, non-production rehearsal, testing, backup, cutover/rollback, communication, monitoring και post-deployment validation.

questions.question_en: How would you assess compatibility before an upgrade?
questions.answer_en: Check vendor support matrices/release notes, OS/DB/APEX/ORDS versions, browser/client needs, custom code, deprecated features, plugins and integrations; test in a representative environment.
questions.answer_el: Ελέγξτε support matrices/release notes, OS/DB/APEX/ORDS versions, browser/client, custom code, deprecated features, plugins/integrations και test representative environment.

questions.question_en: What backups would you take before a major upgrade?
questions.question_el: Τι backups θα παίρνατε πριν major upgrade;
questions.answer_en: Back up all data and configuration needed for recovery using the platform's supported mechanisms, verify backup completion and ensure restore procedure is known/tested.
questions.answer_el: Backup όλων των data/configuration που χρειάζονται για recovery με supported mechanisms, verify completion και γνωστή/tested restore procedure.

questions.question_en: What testing is necessary before a major upgrade?
questions.question_el: Τι testing απαιτείται πριν major upgrade;
questions.answer_en: Functional regression, integrations, database migration, security, performance, accessibility where relevant, operational monitoring, backup/restore and rollback rehearsal.
questions.answer_el: Functional regression, integrations, database migration, security, performance, accessibility όπου relevant, monitoring, backup/restore και rollback rehearsal.

questions.question_en: How would UAT work for an upgrade?
questions.question_el: Πώς θα λειτουργούσε UAT για upgrade;
questions.answer_en: Representative users execute critical business workflows in the upgraded environment against acceptance criteria, record defects and formally approve readiness.
questions.answer_el: Representative users εκτελούν critical business workflows στο upgraded environment βάσει acceptance criteria, καταγράφουν defects και εγκρίνουν readiness.

questions.question_en: What would a rollback plan contain?
questions.answer_en: Rollback trigger/decision authority, exact restoration steps, backups/snapshots, database/data handling, application version, dependencies, communication, time limits and validation.
questions.answer_el: Rollback trigger/decision authority, exact restoration steps, backups/snapshots, database/data handling, app version, dependencies, communication, time limits και validation.

questions.answer_en: Provide affected audience, start/end window, impacted services, expected user impact, preparation/workarounds, status channel and post-restoration notice; update promptly if plans change.
questions.answer_el: Δώστε audience, start/end window, impacted services, expected user impact, preparation/workarounds, status channel και restoration notice· ενημερώστε άμεσα αν αλλάξει plan.

questions.question_en: What post-deployment checks would you perform?
questions.answer_en: Verify health checks, login and critical workflows, database/connectivity, integrations, scheduled jobs, logs/errors, performance, security controls and monitoring/alerts; reconcile key transactions and obtain operational sign-off.
questions.answer_el: Verify health checks, login/critical workflows, database/connectivity, integrations, scheduled jobs, logs/errors, performance, security controls και monitoring/alerts· reconcile key transactions και operational sign-off.
